description: Ankara Atatürk Anadolu lisesi öğrencileri tarafından oluşturulan NASA space apps takımı
summary:
The goal of "Space Base Rescue" was to create a computer-based educational game which would take long, complex documents found on NASA’s official web site and convert those documents into an exciting and interactive educational tool for children. This product was developed specifically for children between the ages of 7 and 12 years old. The game incorporates a variety of game-play features along with actual scientific data so that it can be used as a vehicle to teach space exploration, science and how to solve problems.

Players can go on their space-themed mission alone or as a member of a group using an interactive clan and point system to promote collaboration, social interaction and healthy competition. When players answer science-based trivia (for example, identifying where water ice is located within a dark polar crater) they are rewarded with Star Coins and naturally learn about astronomy.
